51409853.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to LDHA (unknown origin) by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. Human LDHA (100 μg/mL) was immobilized on the chip via amine coupling. The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20, 0.005% Tween-20. Compounds were diluted in running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 nM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. Association and dissociation phases were 180 and 300 seconds, respectively. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine, pH 2.0. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The dissociation rate constant (koff) was determined from the dissociation phase, and the association rate constant (kon) was determined from the association phase. The equilibrium dissociation constant (KD) was calculated as koff/kon. The reported KD values are the mean of at least three independent experiments.
